messages.subject: New proposal on SPatial Econometrics
parts:
Hi,

I have just added a new proposal to translate some Matlab code (for
Bayesian Spatial Econometrics) into R. Interested students can check the
description here:

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2012:sp_econometrics

Anyone interested can contact me off list. Also, remember that the
deadline is this Friday.

Best wishes,
